Get ready for the ultimate Bollywood drama at the Grand Fake Shaadi—a massive mock wedding party hitting Hartford on Oct 9th

About this Event

🌟 The Grand Fake Shaadi: FEAT. DJ Dharak

No Rishta. No Baraatis. Bring your shaadi swag.
No Bride. No Groom.
Fake Shaadi, Real Madness!

Get ready for the ultimate Bollywood drama at The Grand Fake Shaadi—a massive mock wedding club night hitting The Lady Nightclub in Hartford!

This immersive nightlife experience packs all the electric energy, music, and celebration of a multi-day Indian wedding into one wild, high-octane party. Grab your friends, dress to impress, and pick your allegiance at the door. Are you Team Bride or Team Groom?

📅 Event Details
Date: Friday, Oct 9th, 2026Time: 8:00 PM onwardsVenue: The Lady Nightclub, HartfordAdmission: 21+ Only (Valid ID Required)Dress Code: Festive Indian Wear, Bollywood Glam, or Upscale Nightlife Chic💰 SPECIAL OFFER: The first 50 guests who RSVP online and arrive wearing PINK or BLUE before 8:30 PM get FREE ENTRY!🎉 Party Highlights
Live Dhol Welcome: High-energy traditional drum beats greet you at the door to set the vibe.Rep Your Squad: Pick your side at the door (Pink for Team Bride or Blue for Team Groom) and grab custom party favors.Interactive Sangeet Dance-Off: A crowd-interactive music battle pitting the Pink squad against the Blue squad.The Wedding Anthem Blast: A high-impact megamix of the biggest Bollywood wedding anthems transitioning the crowd into full reception mode.The After-Party: Non-stop dancing to heavy Bhangra, legendary Bollywood/Tollywood hits, and exclusive South Asian remixes by DJ Dharak.Themed Cocktails: Specially crafted signature drinks available exclusively at the bar.
